name: cost_monitor
title_zh: 会话日志里揪出最烧钱的十次调用
tagline_zh: 月底对账才发现超支？它从 Hermes 日志逐条算 token 和 API 费用，按预算红线标红超支项。
tagline_en: Surprised by your API bill? It scans Hermes logs line by line, tallies tokens and costs, and flags spend that.
desc_en: Audits LLM token consumption and estimated API costs from Hermes session logs, evaluating spend against budget limits.
why_zh: 不是事后看总账单，而是把每次调用的 token 消耗拆到会话粒度。
why_en: Instead of a lump-sum bill, it breaks cost down per session and alerts you before you blow the budget—so you see which.
limit_zh: 只认 Hermes 的 session 日志格式，其他来源需先转换。
limit_en: Only parses Hermes session logs; other formats need conversion. Estimates token costs only—no retries, cache misses, or discounts. Outputs an audit.
title_en: Find your top 10 costliest calls in session logs
